title: Write unique meta descriptions of up to 155 characters for every zedu.chat page, by Fri 27 Nov
description:
Checked on 22 Oct 2026: of 7 marketing pages, 4 have descriptions of 183 to 185 characters (search results usually cut text at about 155 to 160), and 2 pages share the same text.

Success looks like: each public marketing page has its own description of 155 characters or fewer that says what the page offers and who it is for, with no duplicates across pages. Verify by fetching each page and counting characters, and list old and new text per page.

acceptedWorkstreams.title: Cover all 11 marketing pages, including the product pages, and write each description into the page's code
acceptedWorkstreams.description:
I fetched every marketing page's meta description on 22 Oct 2026, and 10 of 11 are over 155 characters. Besides the pages already listed in the existing approach, the three product pages and Contact Sales are also too long: /products/buzz is 169, /products/channels 175, /products/file-management 168 and /contact-sales 170. Only /download (142) fits.
Tasks, each finishable:
1. New descriptions (content): one per page, 155 characters or fewer, each saying what the page offers and who it's for, with no two alike. Old and new text sit side by side with character counts.
2. Code locations (content): for each page, the file where its metadata export lives in zeduchat/zedu-fe (src/app/(homepage)/...), and the exact before and after lines a developer can paste.
3. Re-check: the curl command that prints each page's description length after deploy, with the expected results.
This extends the existing rewrite approach to the four pages it doesn't list, and turns the copy into ready-to-apply changes.

acceptedWorkstreams.title: Meta descriptions rewritten to under 155 characters, with each one saying what the page gives
acceptedWorkstreams.description: On 22 Oct 2026 I checked the meta description on every public marketing page. Only one is under 155 characters. The homepage is 183, /about is 184, /pricing is 185, /solutions/bootcamps is 176, /solutions/universities is 179, /download is 142. That means search engines are truncating nearly all of them, and the part being kept is usually the least useful half. The rewrite keeps each description under 155 characters, says what the page actually gives the visitor rather than listing the product's features, and uses the same keyword the page's title targets so the two do not compete. Deliverable: a table with the current description, its length, the replacement, its length, and a one-line note on what the new version is for that page. Any claim in the current descriptions that the site does not support is marked for removal rather than rewritten.

acceptedWorkstreams.description: On 22 Oct 2026 home, pricing, about and resources have 183-185 character descriptions, and several are near-copies. Writing them side by side in one table before touching code makes duplicates and length obvious and lets the owner approve the wording once. Tasks: (1) table of every public page: current description and length, the page's real offer and audience (from its own content), and a new description of 140-155 characters; (2) set each in the page's metadata export in zedu-fe and keep openGraph.description in step; (3) re-fetch each page and confirm length and uniqueness with a script.
